intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Plainfield for 2026, and here is what he found: 6 family events, 2 of them free. The magic runs from November 28 (Elves on the Loose and Light Up Main Street) through December 19 (The Nutcracker by The Children's Ballet at Hendricks Live), with uPaint a Story (December 3), Hendricks Symphony Home for the Holidays (December 11 to 13) and A Hometown Holiday at Hummel Park (December 12) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
